I have received so many compliments on my own complexion and the firmness of my skin, that I actually carry a photo of the Beauty Infusion container on my iPhone, so I can show it to people. A waitress at one of the restaurants in my town commented on the beauty of my skin and I told her about the product and the 3 month time frame. I gave her my email address, in case she had any questions. 4 months later, she emailed to tell me that her husband thought that she was crazy to take it and said that it sounded like "snake oil" to him. Then, 3 months later, he saw the change in her skin and now HE is taking it to thicken his thinning skin!. I also have a friend, who has now been on it for a year, tell me that she just saw a friend whom she hasn't seen for almost a year and the friend asked if she had had "work" (surgery) done on her face! I see her every week and the compliments for her started at the 3 month mark and her skin continues to improve.. Being scientifically minded, I have tracked the success of this and have seen this work on all of my friends (over a dozen) that have started using it. The clincher...most of them are in their 50's and 60's. All of them have had noticeable positive results.. The biggest clincher...I am 71 years old, a California sun worshiper who, in the 60's and 70's used baby oil to tan (I know...it was just what we did back then...) and get comments on the beauty of my skin all the time!!! After I had taken it for about 4 months, my doctor actually told me that I look almost 20 years younger and asked if I had "work" done!!! I'm not kidding!!! I use Nivea, but Lubriderm, Eucerin, or Aveeno are good, too.. Also, it works best if taken on an empty stomach.. Anyway, I don't know how it works. I just know that it has worked for me and my friends and others whom I have referred to it and have kept in touch with.. I believe that it's never too late to improve yourself. Try it and see if it works for you too!

One less pill to swallow is always a good thing.. That being said, I'm a little disappointed in the ingredients overall. The amount of Biotin in this multi is rather low compared to some of the other supplements I typically take and while I didn't immediately notice a change in my nails, I still feel it could have been stronger.. The other thing is just the overall vitamin potency itself. It's like they made these weaker in order to add in more biotin. Not sure what the reasoning was there unless they just didn't want them to be SO huge you can't swallow. The pills are pretty big, but no worse than any other daily multivitamin so you shouldn't be shocked if you regularly take a comparable product.. I'm not sure if I'll continue purchasing these as I can buy a much larger bottle of a slightly stronger multivitamin and take extra biotin for less, but if convenience is more important than price... these are certainly worth a look.
